I moved to the area and urgently needed a GP. The NHS website clearly shows this surgery within my catchment area and says they are accepting new patients. I registered yesterday, gave them all my personal details, and thought I finally had a GP — only to get a call today bluntly telling me they “won’t register me” because I’m “outside their catchment.”

This is completely contradictory to the NHS site and shows zero care or accountability. Why accept registrations online if you’re just going to reject them the next day? No apology, no guidance, no effort to help — just “no, we can’t take you.”

For a healthcare provider, this behaviour is unacceptable. They’re wasting people’s time, leaving them without care, and can’t even keep their own NHS listing accurate.
